summary: Zeta Global Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering the issuance of up to $25 million of Class A common stock to a service provider as payment for services, with shares delivered over several fiscal quarters. The number of shares per issuance equals the dollar amount due divided by the five-day VWAP ending before each payment date. The last reported NYSE price was $30.56 on September 10, 2026. This is a routine at-the-market-style shelf takedown for vendor compensation, not a special situation; the main watch item is potential share overhang and dilution timing.
